verified_scope: For any finite ordinary tree rooted at r and any fixed selected original-leaf set F, independent sets partition into the root-absent product of branch independent-set families and the root-present product of T_i-u_i families; ranks are the corresponding sum and one plus sum. The stated weight formula is exact when root-supported tags and the possible r-in-W_v boundary term for support u_i are retained. Root-centered legal switches require exactly two occupied root neighbors; only centers u_i can otherwise cross the root-state boundary, when r and exactly one child are occupied neighbors.
not_established: A weighted Hall inequality for arbitrary subsets of upper-layer states under deletion plus legal two-for-one switches.
A capacity saturation, uncrossing, or injection preserving fixed selector tags and root-boundary states.
The primary complete selected-sum inequality S(T,p)<=0 under its lower-region eligibility hypotheses.
An eligible ordinary-tree counterexample with positive full selected sum.
evidence_grade: direct combinatorial verification of structural identities; no result on Hall feasibility or the primary sum
